Print the effective value of a setting

Print the effective value of a setting: what rp would use now, after flags,
environment variables, the stored profile and the defaults derived from the host.
Profile settings belong to the selected host (--hostname, REPSY_HOST or current_host).

Keys: current_host, product, api_url, registry_url, web_url, owner

```
rp config get <key>
```

## Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --api-url string           Panel API URL of the profile, overrides the stored value
      --ca-file string           PEM file with extra trusted CA certificates
      --debug                    Print debug output with secrets redacted
      --hostname string          Repsy host to use instead of the current profile
      --insecure                 Do not verify TLS certificates (unsafe; plain http is chosen with the URL, not with this flag)
      --jq string                Filter JSON output with a jq expression (implies --output json)
      --no-color                 Disable colored output
      --no-input                 Never prompt; fail when input is needed
      --output table|json|yaml   Output format: table, json or yaml (default table; json when --jq is given)
      --owner string             Owner segment of Cloud protocol URLs; --owner= means none
      --registry-url string      Protocol host URL of the profile, overrides the stored value
      --type os|cloud            Product of the host, overrides detection
      --web-url string           Panel UI URL of the profile (where /cli/auth lives), overrides the stored value
      --yes                      Answer yes to confirmation prompts
```
